sources.license: CC-BY-4.0 for nflverse schedule data, subject to source-specific attribution
sources.role: canonical game_id, gameday, designated teams, location, stadium name and schedule roof field when populated
sources.point_in_time_semantics: Use the schedule row retrieved at resolver runtime and persist retrieval time. Stadium identity is attached to the game rather than inferred from home team.
sources.neutral_site_policy: Use the schedule stadium value for the specific game. Never infer a neutral venue from the designated home team.

sources.role: resolve an exact schedule stadium name or exact returned alias to a Wikidata entity and P625 coordinate
sources.access_policy: Use the MediaWiki Action API with a descriptive User-Agent, maxlag, low request volume and stop/retry behavior for provider rate limits.
sources.identity_rule: A candidate is accepted only when the normalized nflverse stadium string exactly equals the normalized Wikidata label or the exact matched alias/text returned by entity search. Multiple exact QIDs fail closed.
sources.coordinate_rule: Require a non-deprecated P625 statement with finite WGS84 latitude/longitude. Prefer preferred-rank statements; otherwise require an unambiguous normal-rank coordinate.
sources.redistribution: Wikidata structured data is CC0. Retain QID and source URL for auditability even though attribution is not required.

resolver_contract.unresolved_game_policy: Persist an explicit unresolved record and block weather collection for that game until independently resolved.
